payload.title: What change keeps a budget-bound run's last candidate reviewed or named, without review chains?
payload.body: Separating scenarios: replay from cut 1 (run 1, claude-g113-1, after R-8JQPWG: one Result left, a fix commit pending) and cut 2 (run 2, after R-3YJ7T2: one Result left, both probes already pass), 3 trials per arm on Sonnet, against the base at 9c8e498. Measured: is the final candidate reviewed or named, how many new commits follow, and the cost against the base.

why: The question issue #141 puts to the tree; its rivals are the options the owner listed, tested by replay.

payload.title: A candidate's review is part of its gate Experiment
payload.body: One Result carries the test verdicts and the review's limits, so a candidate costs one Experiment. hyp-goal-run says how a review is recorded and that it does not count separately against the budget.

payload.title: The stop checkpoint names each candidate without a review
payload.body: The practice stays (a review is its own Experiment), and hyp-goal-run requires the stop checkpoint to name every candidate commit with no review Result, so the gap is visible to the owner. The floor of line 2; also tested alone.

payload.title: With one Experiment left, review the current candidate instead of committing another fix
payload.body: When the budget allows one more Result, the run reviews the current candidate and stops with recorded limits, and a case whose check already passes closes as a limit and not with a new commit.

why: Rival 3 of issue #141, with the owner's related rule from run 2.

payload.title: The default of --experiments rises to fit a gate and a review per candidate
payload.body: internal/cli/prompt.go default 5 becomes a larger number (for example 7), with prompt_test.go and the prompt-fixture golden file changed with it. It breaks the completed G-ZBM2RE#1, which stays as written; the PR says so.

payload.title: A case the run's own probe ran and passed is closed in the review's Result, not recorded as a limit
payload.body: A limit stays only for a case no check ran or one the candidate fails, so a review that finds only passing cases leads to no fix commit. Run 3's cut after R-JHBCWS shows N1 and P1 closing on 3cfd08d and d2d5d14 with no commit.

why: Rival 5 of issue #141, from the owner's comment of 03:25.

payload.title: The review before the select reads the cumulative diff from the Goal's base
payload.body: The base is the cut's pinned commit, not main. Expected loser: one cumulative review should cost more than 1.5 times the base at each cut; its Experiment pre-registers that prediction and still runs the arm.

why: Rival 6 of issue #141, from the owner's comment of 03:25; the owner expects it to lose on cost.
The issue this build Goal serves.
The parent issue; #141 is part of it.

payload.summary: Grill done: 8 lines written by owner-standin. Q-XFK208 holds six rivals; cuts are run 1 after R-8JQPWG and run 2 after R-3YJ7T2; the run needs --experiments 16. Out-of-Goal: a kind-specific stop clause for discovery Goals needs a Goal kind hyp does not store.
